You guys might remember in the early 90's a DOS game being released called Scorched Earth: The Mother of All Games. You play as a tank, against other tanks, in a turn-based battle. There are dozens of weapons, utilities like parachutes and shields, and you can even watch the computers fight themselves! Back when I was about 8, my sister and I would pit ten computers against each other and bet which one would win the most of 100 rounds.

The game is a bit famous as being one of the best DOS games of all time, and I still go back and play sometimes.
